Meta's total revenue grew about 22% from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025.

- Fiscal 2024 revenue was about $164.5 billion.
- Fiscal 2025 revenue was about $201.0 billion. I summed the four quarters: roughly $42.3B, $47.5B, $51.2B and $59.9B. The fourth-quarter figure is from memory rather than checked against the filing, so it is the least certain input.
- The change is ($201.0B − $164.5B) / $164.5B, which is about 22.2%.
